# Syntyr CSS

> MIT-licensed CSS-first interface system for accessible SaaS, business, and futuristic interfaces. No required JavaScript, build tool, or runtime dependencies. Read release boundaries before generating markup.

The **published immutable release** is v0.3.0-alpha.4 (Grid, Noir, Studio). The main branch currently represents an **unreleased v0.3.0-alpha.5 candidate** with additional themes and modules. Documentation follows current source unless it explicitly refers to the published tag; verify availability against the version you actually install.

## Choose the right representation

For browser readers, use the [human-readable HTML documentation directory](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/reference.html) and [practical HTML guides](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/guides.html). For retrieval by coding agents, most technical-guide links below point to public Markdown sources with the same guide content. The design resources directory is a standalone HTML page. All are served directly without user-agent spoofing or a JavaScript requirement.

## Start here

- [Canonical DESIGN.md contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/DESIGN.md): Agent-readable design rationale and Studio token snapshot generated from source CSS; other themes remain in CSS.
- [AI quickstart](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/ai-quickstart.md): Version-aware CSS installation and valid HTML examples.
- [Complete curated reference](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Concatenated public technical guides, generated from source.
- [Curated web design resources and Syntyr research priorities](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/design-resources.html): Standalone HTML page with 82 curated directories, tools, design systems and libraries, descriptions, links and Syntyr research priorities.
- [Syntyr vs Tailwind vs plain CSS decision guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/tailwind-alternative.html): Source-aware comparison of HTML-first styling, explicit reasons to keep Tailwind or native CSS, and free adoption examples (alpha.5 source preview).
- [Agreed design principles and conformance](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/design-principles.md): Hierarchy, semantic components, states, native HTML recipes, and tested palette roles.
- [Media & Entertainment recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/media-entertainment.md): Optional CSS-only media module and original showcase; unreleased alpha.5 source candidate, not available in published alpha.4.
- [Component reference](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/components.md): Canonical low-entropy standard component inventory, native HTML controls (including range/file/color, datalist/optgroup and named disclosure examples), CSS classes, semantic-mode boundaries and candidate-only table wrapping migration.
- [Component manifest](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/components.json): Curated, validated selectors with their required CSS modules.
- [Copy-owned HTML blocks and local registry adoption](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/blocks-guide.md): 50 original blocks, including service, portfolio, editorial, native navigation, publishing and commerce compositions; dependency-aware offline installer with verified hashes (unreleased alpha.5 candidate).
- [Native form-state contracts example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/form-state-contracts.html): Server-owned validation states, ARIA-linked errors and local CSS overrides (unreleased alpha.5 candidate).
- [Native business workflow example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/native-workflows.html): File input, multi-action form, nested resource disclosure, and linked record details without required JavaScript. See [the guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/native-workflows.md) for server security requirements.
- [Task-based HTML How-To guides](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/how-to.html): Search native HTML workflows for pricing, FAQ, forms, tables, dashboard metrics, onboarding and status notices. Each links to an existing MIT block and the sandboxed editor; examples describe the unreleased alpha.5 source candidate.
- [Interactive component playground](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/playground.html): Search existing gallery snippets, edit HTML in a self-hosted CodeMirror 6 editor (native textarea fallback), adjust scoped panel tokens, switch themes, and preview mobile/desktop widths in a sandboxed browser frame. Optional docs-only JavaScript; the core remains CSS-only.
- [Portable component gallery manifest](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/component-gallery.v1.json): Generated native HTML examples and curated component metadata, for optional visual page builders (unreleased alpha.5).
- [WordPress](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/wordpress.md), [Shopify](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/shopify.md), [Wix](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/wix.md), [Webflow](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/webflow.md), [Framer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/framer.md): practical platform integration guides (and 8 additional platform guides linked from the CMS overview).
- [CMS/site-builder integration](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/site-builders.md): WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Framer, and other hosts; candidate-only unlayered embed CSS and editor/iframe boundaries.
- [Consumer agent skill](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/agents/syntyr/SKILL.md): Portable, opt-in instructions.
- [Contribution policy](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Public repository development, test, release and documentation rules.
- [Private security reporting](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub; never include exploits in public issues.

## FAQ and comparisons

- [FAQ](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/faq.md): Installation, licensing, browser-native behavior, frameworks and release compatibility.
- [CSS framework comparison hub](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/compare.md): Decision guide covering Tailwind, Bootstrap, shadcn/ui, daisyUI, Pico and plain CSS.

## Reference

- [Distribution and pinned CSS](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/distribution.md): Self-hosting, pinned asset URLs, and a downloadable offline SaaS demo in the **unreleased alpha.5** ZIP candidate (not in published alpha.4).
- [Cloudflare hosting and cache contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/cloudflare-hosting.md): Content-addressed website CSS, mutable preview URLs and immutable consumer releases.
- [Experimental Nulang Cloud hosting adapter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/nulang-cloud-hosting.md): Prepare portable static websites and offline deployment bundles; live Nulang Cloud hosting is not yet available.
- [Release freeze and exact-commit approval procedure](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/release-freeze.md): Maintainer-only human approval and evidence gates before freezing the unreleased alpha.5 candidate; technical preflight is not release authorization.
- [Optional npm package tarball audit](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/package-managers.md): Before any separately authorized npm publication, maintainers run `python3 scripts/audit_npm_package.py` to verify the actual archive, source bytes, exports, and allowlisted contents; this does not publish or approve alpha.5.
- [Public API stability](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/api-stability.md): Compatibility and release boundary, including a proposed minimum v1 contract (not yet approved); alpha.5 remains experimental.
- [Optional framework-neutral copy interaction](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/clipboard.md): Native ESM Clipboard API enhancement for HTML/HTMX/React/Vue, progressive fallback and accessible status feedback; experimental alpha.5 source only.
- [Optional native animation companion](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/animation.md): Opt-in CSS-only website fade/slide/zoom effects and finite/infinite loop controls, CSS-only scroll effects, parallax and hover zoom, plus separate Web Animations API, repeat, stagger, viewport helpers and single-cycle dismissal example with reduced-motion support; **unreleased alpha.5**, never required by CSS core.
- [Composition recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/recipes.md): Working responsive layouts and states, including native GET query/filter removal and semantic record review, candidate-only record sheets, workflow progress, diagnostics and approval queues (not in published alpha.4).
- [Filter and record review example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/query-review.html): Copy-owned native HTML using existing Syntyr classes; static illustration only, not a working backend.
- [Opt-in data-grid presentation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/data-grid.md): Styling for host-owned data-grid behavior, ARIA states, and density (unreleased alpha.5 candidate).
- [Machine-readable composition recipe contracts](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/editor-integration.md): Validated component slots, variants, stylesheet modules, and application-owned behavior; opt-in `--semantic` lint checks native input names and literal invoker targets (unreleased alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Figma component kit and source-derived handoff](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/docs/figma-component-kit.md): Unreleased alpha.5 design pilot, source-derived [Figma token handoff JSON](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/metadata/figma/syntyr-handoff.v1.json), CSS/variable reconciliation, and explicitly outstanding native Figma visual parity.
- [Collection workspace and form-recovery example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/resource-workspace.html): Native GET filtering, tabular records and linked field errors; server actions and validation require integration (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Runnable Go resource workbench](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/go-resource-workbench): Server-rendered resource search, sorting, column preferences, Studio/Grid/Noir themes, contextual inspector, real bounded pagination, visible-page checked selection and explicit all-matching previews; fixed fictional data and no production authorization (unreleased alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Permission matrix enterprise example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/permission-matrix.html): Native accessible role/capability review table with labeled checkboxes, keyboard scroll, and server authorization guidance; preview-only, not an access-control implementation (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Workflow operations example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/workflow-operations.html): Three native, copy-owned compositions for server-authoritative progress, sanitized activity logs and approval queues; no live actions or application JavaScript (alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Vertigo-inspired resource workflow HTML example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/vertigo-resource-workflow.html): Copyable index, detail, editor, and settings UI with fictional data and no runtime JavaScript.
- [Optional Vertigo admin integration guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/vertigo-integration.md): Optional MIT Syntyr styling for Vertigo. The static public preview has no backend; separate private local PostGIS and authenticated-tenant development evidence is not a shipped plugin, hosted demo, or paid product.
- [Premium CSS-only compositions and browser validation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/premium-compositions.md): SaaS surfaces, native command presentation, responsive layouts, and maintainer-only Chromium/Firefox/WebKit reflow, keyboard and axe verification (alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Copyable form recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/component-recipes.md): Candidate-only native form groups and accessible markup.
- [Semantic HTML and native workflow recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/semantic-components.md): FAQ disclosures, accessible issue search, grouped choice forms, progress/meter and responsive media; unreleased alpha.5 source candidate.
- [Native dropdowns and selects](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/dropdowns.md): Native action panels, selects, and optional ARIA menu enhancement; alpha.5 source candidate.
- [Native patterns and component imports](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/native-patterns.md): Five native interaction recipes (accordion, GET search, dialog, datalist, meter/output), plus candidate-only browser recipes and individual CSS entrypoints; unreleased alpha.5 source.
- [Web Components authoring contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/component-authoring.md): Optional native Custom Elements and Lit interoperability; safe Declarative Shadow DOM upgrades, disabled no-JavaScript actions, live-region update discipline, and CSS-only core boundary (alpha.5 experimental examples).
- [Enterprise native data tables](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/data-tables.md): Optional sticky headers, zebra rows, keyboard scroll regions and aria-sort indicators; server owns sorting and filtering (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Pico.css migration and semantic starter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/from-pico.md): Candidate-only one-file semantic bundle and migration cautions (not in alpha.4).
- [Optional Radix adapter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/radix-integration.md): State-only styling for projects that already use Radix Primitives.
- [Optional React Aria resource-selection workflow](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/headless-interactions.md): Opt-in React Aria and Radix integration, with local-only inventory filtering, explicit keyboard-accessible selection scope, non-mutating bulk previews and read-only details; server-side selection, authorization and persistence remain application responsibilities (unreleased alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Framework integrations](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/framework-integrations.md): HTMX, server templates, React, a runnable SvelteKit 3 form-action and nested-layout example, and other stacks.
- [Go standard-library HTML server components](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/server-components-go): Copy-owned, zero-JavaScript templates for accessible fields, notices, buttons, tables and pagination; server validation and escaping tests (unreleased alpha.5 source example).
- [Go templ server HTML components](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/server-components-templ): Optional pinned templ adapter with composable field, notice, button, table and pagination examples, tests, and no browser JavaScript (unreleased alpha.5 source example).
- [Node.js standard-library server HTML components](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/server-components-node): Copy-owned HTML components, escaped values, safe pagination links, GET fallback and built-in Node tests with no npm dependencies (unreleased alpha.5 source example).
- [HTMX and Datastar server-component fragments](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/server-components-node/fragments): Optional Node.js GET/SSE example reusing field, notice, button, table and pagination HTML; 422 HTMX validation, history restore, bounded Datastar signals, protected SSE framing and no-JS fallback (unreleased alpha.5 source).
- [Runnable Rust Axum / Askama starter](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/rust-axum): Read-only server-rendered SaaS dashboard with native GET search, validation and no client JavaScript (unreleased alpha.5 source example; not an authentication or production starter).
- [Portable Git-backed CMS starter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/cms-integration.md): static HTML renderer, Sveltia/Pages CMS shared JSON blocks, stable anchors, and editor security boundaries.
- [Static-site generator compatibility](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/static-site-generators.md): Eleventy, Astro, Hugo, Jekyll and Zola self-hosting, deploy-prefix verification, source-candidate release boundaries and zero-required-browser-JavaScript guidance.
- [Mobile and native UI integrations](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/mobile-frameworks.md): Opt-in source adapters for React Native / Expo and portable tokens for Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose, Ionic / Capacitor.
- [Theme tokens and customization](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/theme-customization.md): Supported design token overrides.
- [Visual-intensity and frame-composition guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/visual-intensity.md): Quiet, standard and cinematic effects; zero-JavaScript geometry rules (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Web design reference matrix and benchmark applications](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/design-reference-matrix.md): Ranked design research, licensing boundaries and three reproducible HTML/CSS benchmarks (alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Visual composition and flagship showcases](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/visual-composition.md): Premium restraint, accessible surfaces and responsive Studio, Noir and Grid page examples (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Optional advanced geometry guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/geometry-terminal.md): Seven frame shapes, per-corner cuts, gradient borders, inlays and integration boundaries (alpha.5 source candidate only).
- [Experimental visual page composer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/page-builder-guide.md): Local-only Syntyr page block editor, versioned JSON projects, safe static HTML export and separate CSS file; unreleased alpha.5 source candidate.
- [Interactive geometry mixer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/playground.html#geometry-title): Documentation-only editor with copyable HTML and no consumer runtime JavaScript (alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Accessibility guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/accessibility.md): Practical verification.
- [Alpha.5 accessibility review](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/accessibility-alpha5-review.md): Pinned automated evidence, unresolved contrast targets, and manual release gates.
- [Progressive CSS loading](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/progressive-loading.md): Selective CSS, critical CSS tradeoffs, and measured loading approaches.
- [Deployed mobile performance audit](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/live-performance-audit.md): Reproducible LCP, caching, CSP and accessibility evidence for the hosted business and SaaS examples.
- [Optional visualization styles](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/viz.md): SVG/HTML rendering and boundaries.
- [Optional geospatial map UI](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/geo.md): Renderer-neutral markers, legends, accessibility, and a repo-only Python standard-library GET-filtering demo with district drill-down, and a developer-only real-MapLibre map/list/inspector browser harness (with app-owned state and server-owned authorization requirements); alpha.5 source only.
- [How to use Syntyr with coding agents](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/agent-integration.md): Recommended prompts, retrieval and validation.

## Commercial research (not for sale)

- [Syntyr Console Kit concept](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/console-kit.html): Separately authored, eight-screen private prototype with static screenshot previews and fictional data. **Not for sale:** no checkout, preorder, binding commercial license or working backend. The page offers a private preview request through the visitor's email app and a separate integration quote inquiry; neither is an order. All existing CSS, themes, components and public examples remain MIT licensed. Do not publish or claim access to the private kit source.
- [Product and proposed pricing overview](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/products.html): MIT core availability and not-for-sale premium product concepts only.
- [Commercial product metadata](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/commercial-offers.json): Machine-readable availability and research-only pricing hypotheses; never treat them as purchasable products.

## Assets

- [Pinned v0.3.0-alpha.4 core stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.core.css)
- [Expanded 32-example native HTML component catalog](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/catalog.html): Category-filtered copyable examples for typography, forms, navigation, data tables, media, semantic content and interactive HTML, including optional recipes, geometry and visualization modules (unreleased alpha.5 source candidate; load the indicated CSS module for each example).
- [Current experimental component gallery](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/)

- [Intrinsic composition and adoption](docs/composition-adoption.md) — wrapping clusters and sidecars without JavaScript.

- [Syntyr CSS Blog](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/blog/): Practical articles on CSS-first design, semantic HTML, accessibility, and copy-owned UI blocks.

- Guided first-project starter wizard: https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/starter-wizard.html (docs-only optional JavaScript; published alpha.4 assets)
